Director, Technical Program Management
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

GitHub is looking for a director to help lead GitHub’s Technical Program Management team in our Engineering organization. You should be an ambitious, passionate, technical, and collaborative leader with a strong background in empowering high performing teams and an ability to deliver results through technical programs. 


The Director, TPM will strengthen TPM's role as a trusted integrator, driving clarity, accountability, and execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives. They will help teams frame problems, align stakeholders, and accelerate decision-making while raising the effectiveness of TPMs and scaling their influence across the company. This director will foster a culture of ownership, bias for action, and operational excellence, ensuring execution remains tightly aligned with strategic priorities. 


Responsibilities

Opportunity and Solutions Identification 

  • Demonstrates and builds experiences across multiple groups or divisions. Leads and coaches teams to develop problem statements and form hypotheses for products and services across divisional boundaries to address highly complex business, program, customer needs, and/or market opportunities; identifies dependencies of other features. 

  • Determines and leads process improvements to quickly scope insights, and drives change management initiatives. Uses industry understanding to direct teams to ensure alignment between the customer, the market, internal stakeholders, senior leadership, and the goals and strategy of GitHub. 

  • Holds teams accountable for collaborating with others (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Design) to ensure that they can satisfy customer requirements. Provides expertise to help teams validate the market size and opportunity of greatest value for the company. Facilitates collaboration between their team and other partner teams to bring about solutions. 

 

Program Planning and Success 

  • Provides expertise to help teams define the multiple program goals and prioritization for the products and services they own. Guides teams to translate the needs of the organization and other teams into program goals and prioritize deliverables based on data insights.  

  • Guides teams to engage in active risk management (proactive and reactive) to identify risks and propose mitigations for risks using data (e.g., telemetry, usage, net satisfaction, customer satisfaction). 

  • Coaches teams to define success criteria and performance metrics (e.g., Objectives and Key Results [OKRs], Key Performance Indicators [KPIs] such as quality and performance) of products, services and works with engineering to ensure needed telemetry is developed. Provides expert knowledge to help teams deeply understand the return on investment. 

  

Program/Service Development 

  • Acts as a subject matter expert in orchestrating and integrating efforts for the development and implementation process of product, services on large cross functional projects with internal teams and external partners. Drives teams to collaborate and coordinate across teams and perspectives to ensure alignment on product management and release, including tradeoffs, adjustments, and improvements as feasible. 

  • Guides teams to partner with the engineering team to contribute, prioritize, and deliver on the roadmap for product, service. Drives teams to understand the value proposition for the feature(s)/feature areas and answer technical questions on the feature(s)/feature areas they own.  

  • Guides teams to justify capacity requirements and advocate for the right resource allocation. Partners with the Engineering team to know the feature capabilities in alignment with the goal updates and associated tradeoffs. 

  • Guides teams tracking, coordinating, and communicating end-to-end project schedules for products, services. Ensures teams establish and monitor processes, and hold other stakeholders accountable for following the established schedule and processes. 

  • Guides teams when tracking and managing dependencies to enable cohesive, connected user scenarios, and to avoid issues and mitigate risks. Coaches teams to make adjustments or course corrections when projects are not aligned to schedules or goals. 

  • Drives teams to develop the staging and implementation plan for piloting/release in alignment with Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for products, services, its development timeline, and the introduction to the different programs. Ensures teams collaborate with stakeholders to monitor progress and adjust as needed. 

  • Helps teams lead governance programs and processes to ensure that specific performance requirements and standards are met throughout the development lifecycle (e.g., quality, compliance, privacy, security, safety, accessibility). 

 

Continuous Improvement 

  • Provides expertise to help teams partner with others to collect performance metrics (e.g., Key Performance Indicators [KPIs] such as usage, quality, speed, and cost), monitor and report on progress (e.g., business reviews), and derive insights that lead to productive courses of action. 

  • Ensures teams share insights with Engineering and other partners. Leads teams to form hypotheses to technical needs, perform experiments, and iterate to drive improvement in specific performance metrics that have measurable impact. 


Qualifications

Required Qualifications 

  • 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 4+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years experience in managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years people management experience.
  • 4+ years experience designing, building, or supporting software systems. 

Compensation Range

The base salary range for this job is USD $140,400.00 - USD $372,300.00 /Yr.

These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.

This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

EEO Statement

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

Description

The Sr Mgr Product Management-Tech will drive forward-looking product strategy and new initiatives for Amazon’s tablet portfolio. This leader will own the vision for exciting future programs, translating emerging customer needs and technology trends into compelling product concepts that influence to our multi-generational roadmap. You will work at the intersection of hardware, software, and services—partnering across engineering, design, and business teams to bring transformative products from concept through successful launch.

We’re seeking an exceptional product leader with a proven track record of envisioning and delivering innovative consumer electronics products at scale. You have successfully planned and launched products that customers love—ideally in tablets, phones, and mobile platforms. You bring deep experience in product planning across multiple product generations, a strong technical foundation that enables you to partner effectively with engineering teams, and the ability to translate ambiguous customer problems into clear product strategies. You thrive in fast-paced environments where you must balance long-term vision with disciplined execution, and you have a demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership and drive alignment across complex, matrixed organizations.

Key job responsibilities

- Identify opportunities that leverage emerging technologies, evolving customer behaviors, and market trends

- Lead product planning for future programs from concept through launch, including defining product requirements, making trade-off decisions, and driving alignment across hardware, software, and services teams

- Develop compelling product visions and strategies that articulate where the tablet category is headed and how Amazon will win, influencing VP and Director-level stakeholders

- Contribute to end-to-end product development and successful product launches, partnering with engineering, design, operations, and go-to-market teams to deliver on time and at quality

- Translate deep customer insights, competitive intelligence, and technology trends into actionable product strategies that shape multi-generational planning

- Own key business metrics and success criteria for future programs, using data-driven analysis to inform investment priorities and product decisions

- Contribute to the broader Devices product strategy by identifying cross-portfolio opportunities and driving innovation that scales beyond tablets

- Mentor product managers and build organizational capability through thought leadership and raising the bar on product excellence

- Bring a strong technical foundation, with a solid understanding of both hardware and software

Basic Qualifications

- 6+ years of team management experience

- Bachelor's degree

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

- 8+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience

- Experience with end to end product delivery

- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience delivering consumer software products and services in a high growth environment

- Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements

- Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

title: Associate Vice President (AVP) of PMO and Delivery
description:
We're looking to grow our Delivery Leadership Team at NLS!

Are you a seasoned delivery leader who knows what it takes to get complex technology programs across the finish line, consistently and at scale? If you're ready to bring people, methodology, and governance together under one clear vision, we've got the opportunity for you!

As our Associate Vice President (AVP) of PMO and Delivery, you'll provide unified executive leadership for our Project Management Office and Delivery Lead departments. You'll partner closely with the SVP of Delivery and own the end-to-end health of NLS project and program delivery, from methodology and staffing to KPIs, budget, and client outcomes.

If you thrive as a trusted advisor, love building high-performing teams, and are ready to shape the future of delivery at a Duck Creek Partner of the Year, we'd love to meet you!

*We know you care about benefits and perks, so feel free to scroll down to that section, and then scroll back up to learn more about this role.

What You'll Do:

  • Own accountability for the performance, quality, and delivery outcomes of the PMO and Delivery Lead departments

  • Directly lead, coach, and evaluate PMO leaders and Delivery Leads through strategic direction, mentorship, and performance management

  • Partner with the SVP of Delivery and other NLS leaders to set and execute annual strategic goals for both departments

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by aligning solutions to business objectives and influencing key decisions

  • Own PMO strategy, including staffing model, resourcing, and methodology standards (Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Waterfall)

  • Ensure the NLS Delivery Assurance Program (iDAP) and NLS Project Playbook are adapted to every implementation type, platform, and SOW structure, and that both are consistently followed

  • Develop, monitor, and report enterprise-level KPIs and delivery metrics, turning trends into action plans

  • Manage the combined PMO and Delivery Lead budget to keep finances healthy and resources well allocated

  • Resolve escalated delivery risks and act as the executive escalation point for high-priority, complex engagements

  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and innovation, including the adoption of AI and emerging tools

  • Lead succession planning, talent development, and the 360-degree feedback process for department leadership

  • Partner with sales, account management, and delivery leadership to align resourcing, pipeline, and project outcomes

  • Represent PMO and Delivery in growth initiatives, pre-sales support, and strategic partner discussions, including the Duck Creek partner program

  • Ensure delivery practices align with data privacy, security, and compliance standards

  • Drive the interview, onboarding, and training strategy for the PMO and Delivery Lead leadership pipeline

What You'll Bring:

  • 15+ years of experience in the technology services industry, including 7+ years in a senior leadership role overseeing multiple teams or departments

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or a related field (Master's preferred)

  • Proven track record leading both project/program delivery and delivery quality or governance functions

  • Experience managing budgets of $10M+ and enterprise-level KPI or reporting programs

  • Deep understanding of project management methodologies and delivery governance frameworks

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 (including MSP) and JIRA, ADO, or similar delivery tools

  • Strong analytical and risk management skills, with the ability to turn KPI and iDAP data into actionable strategy

  • Executive-level communication and presentation skills with senior leadership, clients, and strategic partners

  • Strong leadership, coaching, and team development experience across multiple layers of management

  • A servant leadership mindset and the highest degree of honesty and integrity

  • A results-driven approach and a strong aptitude for leading change at the organizational level

  • Certification in at least four project management areas (CSM, ACP, PMP, SAFe, etc.) preferred

  • Duck Creek Technologies and Property & Casualty Insurance delivery experience strongly preferred

  • Ability to work outside primary hours (Monday–Friday, 8AM–5PM local time) and travel as needed

Location: Remote, or in one of our offices in Springfield, MO or Puerto Rico

Why join NLS?

Bring your authentic self to the Next Level Solutions team! Go-getter. Learner. Team Oriented.

If this sounds like you, consider joining our team! Our culture is what makes us who we are. We work hard, but we have fun doing it! We believe that knowledge should be shared. Shared knowledge fosters our collaborative workplace culture, where our people work together towards achieving company goals. This environment promotes continuous learning and professional development.

description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About This Role

Crusoe is scaling one of the fastest-growing global workplace and data center portfolios in the industry, with active real estate initiatives spanning San Francisco, Denver, London, Tel Aviv, Bellevue, and beyond, alongside a rapidly expanding global data center footprint. We're looking for a Senior Director, Real Estate & Portfolio Strategy to lead the strategy, execution, and financial management of our global co-location, manufacturing office and data center lease portfolio.

Reporting directly to the VP, DIG Operations, this role will be a critical partner in aligning our real estate strategy with business growth, headcount planning, employee experience, and long-term financial objectives across both corporate office, co-location, manufacturing and data center real estate. You'll work closely with our exclusive global brokerage partner, Legal, Finance, People, Data Center Operations, and business leaders to deliver thoughtful, data-driven real estate solutions that support Crusoe's continued expansion.

This is an exciting opportunity for a senior real estate leader who thrives on managing multiple concurrent transactions across office, manufacturing and data center/colocation portfolios, enjoys the financial and analytical side of commercial real estate, and wants to build scalable portfolio strategies, lease governance, and audit processes for a rapidly growing global company.

 

What You'll Be Working On

 

• Portfolio Strategy and Asset Management: by partnering with Finance, People, Workplace, and Data Center Operations leadership to translate hiring forecasts, capacity plans, and space/power utilization into real estate recommendations. Evaluate expansion, consolidation, renewal, and exit opportunities across global office and data center markets.

• Lease Portfolio Management: own the master lease abstract database across all locations, tracking key dates, terms, options, renewal windows, and obligations to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

• Lease Review & Abstracting: lead comprehensive lease review and abstracting for new and existing leases, including manufacturing office, data center, and cloud colocation agreements — abstracting key business, financial, and legal terms into standardized formats for portfolio-wide tracking and reporting.

• Transaction Execution: manage end-to-end real estate transactions — including new office and manufacturing leases, renewals, subleases, expansions, contractions, and terminations — in close partnership with our brokers and legal counsel.

• Cloud Colocation & Data Center Lease Management: lead ongoing lease management for cloud colocation and data center leases, including power/capacity commitments, service level agreements, interconnection terms, expansion rights, and hyperscaler lease administration.

• Critical Date Management: own the tracking and management of all critical lease dates across the portfolio — including notice periods, renewal and termination options, rent escalations, expansion/contraction windows, and compliance deadlines — ensuring proactive action ahead of key milestones.

• Financial Analysis & Reporting: build and maintain cash flow models, occupancy cost analyses, rent schedules, lease comparisons, escalations, and CAM reconciliations to support executive decision-making across office, manufacturing and data center portfolios.

• Executive Reporting: prepare business cases, portfolio updates, and executive presentations that translate complex lease and financial data into clear, actionable recommendations for executive leadership.

• Stakeholder Coordination: serve as the primary point of contact between Workplace, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Data Center Operations, and site leadership on all lease-related matters, including purchase order and approval workflows in Coupa.

• Broker & Transaction Management: serve as the relationship manager for Crusoe's global brokerage partner, leading lease negotiations, coordinating transaction strategy, and driving favorable business and financial outcomes across the portfolio.

• Compliance, Risk & Audit Management: track insurance requirements, certificates of occupancy, permits, and critical lease obligations across office and data center locations; manage lease and portfolio audits, proactively identifying and mitigating portfolio risks.

• Site Selection: partner with brokers and internal stakeholders on new market evaluations, including market analysis, site tours, financial comparisons, and lease execution for both office and manufacturing sites.

• Portfolio Systems & Process Improvement: lead the evaluation and implementation of a global lease administration platform while continuously improving portfolio reporting, documentation, and governance — including audit readiness — to support Crusoe's continued growth.

 

What You'll Bring to the Team

• Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Business, Finance, or a related field.

• 15+ years of experience in corporate real estate, portfolio strategy, lease administration, or commercial real estate transaction management, including experience with data center or cloud colocation leasing.

• Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent lease transactions across multiple geographies and asset types, including office and data center/colocation.

• Strong financial acumen, including developing business cases, cash flow projections, occupancy cost analyses, lease economics, and executive recommendations.

• Hands-on experience with lease review, abstracting, and management, including tracking of critical dates, options, and obligations across a large, complex portfolio.

• Experience negotiating commercial lease terms in partnership with brokers and legal counsel, including colocation and data center-specific terms (power, SLAs, interconnection, expansion rights).

• Experience leading or supporting lease and portfolio audits, with a strong understanding of compliance and risk management practices.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing cross-functional partners and executive leadership without direct authority.

• Experience implementing or administering lease management software is highly desirable.

• Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets with strong financial modeling and analytical skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex real estate and financial information for executive audiences.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving business priorities.

 

Bonus Points

• Experience in a high-growth technology, AI, data center, or manufacturing environment.

• Experience working directly with a global brokerage firm (e.g., JLL, CBRE, Cushman & Wakefield).

• Experience supporting international real estate transactions and global portfolios.

• Direct experience with hyperscaler or wholesale data center lease structures and negotiations.

Additional perks & programs specific to location

Overview

GitHub's Pull Request Platform powers one of the most critical developer workflows in the world. Every pull request operation across GitHub.com, the API, and GitHub Enterprise Server depends on the systems this team owns. The team is responsible for pull request state, mergeability, indexing, automation, and platform reliability, serving tens of millions of developers who collaborate, review code, and ship software every day. 

 

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help lead Pull Request Platform through a period of significant technical investment. The team is strengthening production reliability in a complex, high-traffic area, contributing to GitHub's service-extraction efforts, and evolving its infrastructure to meet growing scale requirements. You'll join our Core Productivity organization and directly influence the reliability and performance of one of GitHub's most visible and heavily used features. 

 

As a staff engineer, you'll be a hands-on technical leader who shapes architecture, guides complex initiatives, and helps the team turn ambiguous problems into durable solutions. You'll work across Git operations, databases, search, APIs, and asynchronous workflows while helping define the platform's longer-term technical direction. 

 

This work blends distributed systems experience with pragmatic execution — moving between writing and reviewing code, leading architectural decisions, improving production systems, and building alignment across organizational boundaries. You'll partner closely with Pull Request Experience, Repositories Platform, Git Systems, and other teams across GitHub while mentoring engineers and helping the team grow its technical practices. 


Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, implementation, and evolution of systems that power pull requests at GitHub scale. 

  • Help define and execute the Pull Request Platform technical roadmap, aligning engineering investments with GitHub’s reliability, scalability, and service-extraction priorities. 

  • Solve complex technical challenges spanning Git operations, databases, search and indexing, APIs, and asynchronous workflows. 

  • Design, develop, test, and ship maintainable solutions that operate across multiple GitHub services. 

  • Own and advocate for the health of the team’s production systems, including participating in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident improvements. 

  • Set high standards for operational safety, testing, observability, deployment practices, and production rollouts. 

  • Write architecture briefs and technical proposals, conduct code experiments, and clearly communicate tradeoffs and operational risks. 

  • Partner across engineering teams to define scalable interfaces, reduce system friction, and lead initiatives such as service extraction and platform hardening. 

  • Provide technical leadership through mentorship, pairing, code and design reviews, and guidance that helps other engineers deliver extensible, maintainable systems. 

  • Improve engineering and operational excellence through automation, tooling, and standardization across testing, deployment, and operations.

As our organization scales, we are fundamentally transforming how we deliver value to our customers. Introducing our advanced robots into dynamic, unstructured environments requires a seamless, enterprise-grade support ecosystem.

Reporting directly to the VP of Customer Experience, the Director of CX Strategy and Portfolio Management will pioneer our shift to treating Customer Experience (CX) as a formalized product. In this role, you will own the strategic roadmap and manage a complex portfolio of initiatives designed to mature the entire CX lifecycle from onboarding and deployment through service, and support. Crucially, this is an inherently non-siloed, connective function; success demands radical, deep-seated collaboration across every single pillar of the business—integrating CX, Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering into one unified, high-velocity engine.

Key Responsibilities

CX Vision and Strategy

This leader will be responsible for four pillars of creating the world's best Customer Experience engine for the world's most advanced unstructured robotic solutions:

Pillar I: CX Product Innovation & Customer Obsession

Product Leadership: Directly manage one Product Manager to productize the end-to-end customer journey with the same rigor as hardware development.

Zero-Friction Mandate: Drive the strategy for "zero friction" scores by translating customer obsession into actionable product requirements and seamless onboarding experiences.

Pillar II: Portfolio & Technical Program Delivery

TPM Management: Lead and mentor a team of three Technical Program Managers (TPMs) to oversee the execution of the CX strategic roadmap.

Serviceability & Scale: Focus the TPM team on maturing legacy systems, improving serviceability, and deploying introspective tooling that enables the CX organization to scale globally.

Pillar III: Strategic CX Integration & Alignment

Executive Partnership: Serve as the primary strategic partner to the VP of Customer Experience, translating high-level vision into actionable, enterprise-wide strategy.

Cross-Functional Synergy: Drive organizational alignment across departmental silos, managing stakeholder relationships to ensure unified outcomes across the entire CX lifecycle.

Pillar IV: Rapid Prototyping & AI/Enterprise Tooling

Dev Team Leadership: Manage a small, dedicated scrum team of developers to rapidly prototype internal tools and advanced CX capabilities.

Tooling Ownership: Own the incubation and iteration of AI initiatives and enterprise tools (e.g., Salesforce) through to the point of handover to the BizOps team.

BizOps Collaboration: Partner closely with BizOps Data Science and BizOps PMO teams to ensure technical prototypes are scalable and data-driven before full enterprise integration.

Experience: 15+ years of leadership experience in Product Management, Portfolio/Program Management, or CS Strategy, ideally within a scaling B2B technology, hardware, or robotics company.

Methodology Mastery: Deep fluency in product management methodologies (Agile, journey mapping, discovery frameworks) and portfolio management best practices (governance, resource leveling, strategic road mapping).

Systems Architecture & Scaling: A proven track record of taking immature operational processes and scaling them into robust, enterprise-grade systems capable of supporting complex, global deployments.

Change Management Expertise: Demonstrated experience leading large-scale organizational change (e.g., ADKAR or similar frameworks). Excellence in bringing disparate stakeholders together and leading through influence without direct authority.

Customer Obsession & Analytics: A relentless drive to advocate for the user, coupled with the analytical acumen to translate qualitative feedback and quantitative metrics into actionable product requirements.

Exceptional Communication: The ability to seamlessly translate complex operational realities between deep technical engineering teams and customer-facing service personnel.

description:
The Modular Manufacturing & Integration organization is leading an industry-defining transformation in how Google delivers technical infrastructure for the AI era. Transitioning away from conventional, on-site, purpose-built construction, our mission is to industrialize data center delivery through mass-assembled, standardized modules and off-site manufacturing.

By pushing labor-intensive assembly, systems integration, and quality testing upstream into controlled factory environments, we enable "square wave" capacity delivery—turning on gigawatt-scale AI compute, liquid cooling, power distribution, and network fabric with unprecedented velocity. Operating across AI Systems & Infrastructure (AI2), Google Data Centers (GDC), Systems & Manufacturing (ISM), and Google Global Infrastructure (GGI), our team defines the modular technical product and serves as the accountable business owner for industrializing and landing modular capacity globally.

As the Principal TPM of Manufacturing & Industrial Engineering, you will be the chief industrial architect responsible for translating Google’s modular infrastructure strategy into an executable, manufacturing reality. In this principal technical leadership role—with the charter to incubate the discipline and potentially scale a dedicated team over time—you will bridge the gap between design engineering, external contract manufacturing, and on-site field execution.

Your remit spans the entire physical and technical stack: structural modules, medium-to-low voltage power skids, liquid cooling distribution, and dense AI compute hardware. You will evaluate current field deployment and operations bottlenecks and establish scalable manufacturing processes with global contract manufacturers and fabricators. Your core mandate is simple yet radical: dramatically compress the timeline from factory gate to live AI compute, reduce complexity of assembly in manufacturing and in the field, and increase first pass yield/quality of the entire data center system.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $281000 - $391000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 15 years of technical program management, manufacturing engineering, or industrial engineering experience spanning integrated physical/hardware systems.
  • 10 years of experience applying Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFM/A), Lean Manufacturing, and process optimization to electromechanical or mission-critical systems.
  • 10 years of experience working directly with external Contract Manufacturers (CMs), Original Design Manufacturers (ODMs), or specialized industrial fabricators to stand up assembly and test lines.

Preferred qualifications:

Description

Enterprise Engineering builds and operates the internal tools, platforms, and AI-powered services that enable over 1.5 million Amazonians to do their best work every day — from endpoint management and collaboration to innovative productivity experiences, all at massive global scale. We're seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead high-impact, cross-functional, company wide projects. This role requires working closely with product management to define strategy and requirements, collecting business and systems requirements from customers and business units, writing specifications, and leading development teams from design through delivery and subsequent operation. You will be expected to make appropriate trade-offs to optimize launch timelines, clearly communicate goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes to internal cross-functional project teams. This position involves regular communication with senior management on status, risks, and product strategy. Excellent listening, writing skills, executive communication and very strong technical competency are essential.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong program management background, will have demonstrated experience leading medium to large projects through multiple complete product development cycles, and will have a well-rounded technical background in current technologies. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in, and get the job done. You will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make trade-offs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop detailed functional and test specifications, schedule, and deploy new feature sets in a successful and timely manner is expected. Maturity, high product judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent, and leadership are essential to success in this role. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- 5+ years of software development experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience

- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

description:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

 

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

 

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Staff Tech Portfolio Manager, Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS)

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and execution-focused Staff Tech Portfolio Manager to lead enterprise Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) programs that improve developer productivity, platform reliability, operational readiness, and business delivery. This role partners across Engineering, Architecture, Product, Security, Risk, Finance, Operations, and application teams to translate platform strategy into actionable roadmaps, measurable outcomes, and scalable execution.

Key Responsibilities

Lead cross-functional planning, prioritization, sequencing, and delivery for high-impact PaaS platform programs, ensuring alignment across platform services, consuming application teams, and enterprise priorities.

Define and manage platform roadmaps, dependencies, risks, milestones, adoption plans, governance checkpoints, and executive-level status reporting.

Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Security, Risk, Operations, and Finance to ensure platform investments support scalability, reuse, compliance, resiliency, cost efficiency, and measurable business value.

Establish and track platform KPIs, including adoption, reliability, developer experience, time-to-market, operational health, supportability, and cost efficiency.

Drive delivery excellence through agile, iterative, and outcome-oriented practices, ensuring programs are supported by clear documentation, adoption playbooks, readiness plans, and post-launch learning.

Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders by translating technical priorities, delivery tradeoffs, platform risks, and investment decisions into clear business outcomes.

Promote consistent platform consumption, standards, best practices, and change readiness across application teams and internal platform stakeholders.

Evaluate emerging platform technologies, automation capabilities, developer tools, and operational practices that improve delivery speed, reliability, and developer experience.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience leading enterprise technology, program management, or platform portfolios with ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives.

Strong understanding of enterprise platform capabilities, including developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, shared services, APIs, container platforms, integration services, and core enterprise systems.

Demonstrated ability to partner with architecture and engineering leaders while maintaining a customer-, business-, and outcome-oriented perspective.

Proven track record delivering high-impact programs in ambiguous environments while managing dependencies, risks, stakeholders, and measurable outcomes.

Strong influence and communication skills, with the ability to align technical, business, security, compliance, and operations stakeholders.

Experience with agile, lean, and iterative delivery models applied to platform or enterprise-scale initiatives.

Ability to build and present executive-ready roadmaps, dashboards, adoption plans, and impact stories using tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, Jira, Aha!, or similar platforms.

Preferred Experience & Certifications

Experience with PaaS capabilities such as container platforms, messaging, workflow orchestration, API management, file exchange, databases, caching, identity, certificate management, monitoring, and infrastructure automation.

General Familiarity with Infrastructure and Platform services and their purpose like Kubernetes, Azure, AWS, Terraform, CI/CD platforms, observability tooling, and enterprise service management practices.

Preferred certifications include SAFe, PMP, PMI-PgMP, Certified Scrum Professional, cloud platform certifications, or relevant product/program management credentials.

 

Annual Salary
$115,000.00 - $230,000.00
The above annual salary range is a general guideline. Multiple factors are taken into consideration to arrive at the final hourly rate/ annual salary to be offered to the selected candidate. Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

 
At this time, GEICO will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

Great Company: Protecting customers through life’s twists and turns with innovation and integrity.

Great Careers: Personalized development programs, mentorship, and certification assistance.

Great Culture: Inclusive and collaborative culture rooted in shared success.

Great Rewards: Competitive pay, benefits, and flexibility to support your well-being and future.

GEICO hires and promotes individuals solely on the basis of their qualifications for the job to be filled.

 

GEICO reasonably accommodates qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to receive equal employment opportunity and/or perform the essential functions of the job, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship to the Company. This applies to all applicants and associates. GEICO also provides a work environment in which each associate is able to be productive and work to the best of their ability. We do not condone or tolerate an atmosphere of intimidation or harassment. We expect and require the cooperation of all associates in maintaining an atmosphere free from discrimination and harassment with mutual respect by and for all associates and applicants.

description:
Über Rotzinger Transver

Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie.

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com.

Rotzinger Transver ist Teil von Coesia, einer weltweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe für innovative Industrie- und Verpackungslösungen mit Hauptsitz in Bologna. Coesia ist in 34 Ländern vertreten, vereint 21 Unternehmen und beschäftigt per 2026 mehr als 8'000 Mitarbeitende weltweit.

Über die Rolle

Als Head of Project Management (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für das Projektportfolio an unseren Produktionsstandorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf. Sie führen ein Team von Project Managern und sorgen für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung unserer internationalen Kundenprojekte. Dabei treiben Sie die Weiterentwicklung des Projektmanagements aktiv voran und tragen dazu bei, Projekte effizienter, transparenter und profitabler umzusetzen.

Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortungen

  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung des PMO-Teams über beide Standorte hinweg

  • Steuerung und Priorisierung des Projektportfolios in Abstimmung mit den Unternehmenszielen

  • Sicherstellung der erfolgreichen Umsetzung komplexer Kundenprojekte hinsichtlich Qualität, Kosten und Termine

  • Aktives Management von Risiken, Änderungen und Projektprofitabilität

  • Überwachung relevanter KPIs und Förderung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Sales und Service

  • Weiterentwicklung von Projektmanagement-Standards, Prozessen und Methoden

  • Professionelles Stakeholder- und Kundenmanagement über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus


Was Sie mitbringen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement sowie Führungserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Rolle

  • Erfahrung in der erfolgreichen Leitung komplexer Kundenprojekte

  • Erfahrung im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau oder einem vergleichbaren industriellen Umfeld

  • Technischer Hochschulabschluss oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Unternehmerisches Denken und ein gutes Verständnis für Kosten, Margen und Projektprofitabilität

  • Projektmanagement-Zertifizierungen wie PMP oder IPMA von Vorteil

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Führungs- und Veränderungskompetenzen

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Reisebereitschaft zwischen den Standorten sowie zu internationalen Kunden (ca. 20–30 %)

Was wir bieten

  • Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld

  • Attraktive Sozialleistungen und ein modernes Altersvorsorgemodell

  • Vergünstigungen beim Fahrzeugkauf

  • Dienstjubiläums- und Treueprämien

  • Unterstützung bei Aus- und Weiterbildungen

  • 25 Ferientage bis zum Alter von 49 Jahren, 28 Tage ab 50 Jahren und 30 Tage ab 60 Jahren

  • Kostenlose Parkplätze

  • Gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Verkehr

  • Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg (Profit Sharing)

description:
Job Title:

Senior Director, Enterprise Portfolio Management

Job Description:

The Role:

Entegris is seeking a Senior Director, Enterprise Portfolio Management Office (EPMO) to lead portfolio governance, demand management, and delivery oversight for strategic technology and digital transformation initiatives. 

This leader will partner closely with business and technology executives to ensure investments are aligned to company priorities, appropriately funded and resourced, and delivered in a predictable manner. This leader will establish the processes and governance required to move initiatives efficiently from idea through execution and value realization while driving transparency, accountability, and business outcomes across the portfolio. 

The ideal candidate combines strong portfolio and program leadership experience with the ability to influence executive decision-making, lead organizational change, and improve the effectiveness of enterprise technology investments. 

This position reports directly to the Chief Information & Digital Officer. It will be based local to one of our hubs, ideally in Chaska, MN, Bedford, MA, or Aurora, IL.

 

What You’ll Do:

Enterprise Portfolio Leadership & Governance

Lead the Enterprise Portfolio Management Office (EPMO), establishing portfolio management, governance, and delivery practices that enable successful execution of strategic initiatives.

Oversee enterprise portfolio governance, prioritization, funding, and investment decision-making to ensure alignment with business objectives and organizational capacity.

Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on portfolio strategy, investment priorities, risks, and tradeoffs.

Demand Management & Portfolio Prioritization

Own the enterprise demand management process, providing a transparent framework for evaluating, prioritizing, and approving technology and digital investments.

Lead the end-to-end portfolio lifecycle from intake and business case development through execution and value realization.

Develop portfolio metrics and reporting that provide visibility into demand, capacity, delivery performance, and investment outcomes.

Resource Planning & Portfolio Optimization

Lead enterprise-wide capacity planning and resource forecasting to balance demand, funding, and organizational readiness.

Facilitate executive decision-making regarding investment priorities, resource allocation, and portfolio tradeoffs.

Continuously evaluate portfolio performance and recommend adjustments to maximize business value and delivery effectiveness.

Strategic Program Oversight

Provide executive oversight for large-scale, cross-functional technology and business transformation initiatives.

Ensure effective risk management, governance, financial stewardship, and delivery

Executive Reporting & Value Realization

Provide executive leadership with a consolidated view of portfolio performance, investment health, risks, and realized business value.

Establish value realization measures and drive continuous improvement across portfolio management, governance, and delivery practices.

Organizational Leadership & PMO Maturity

Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing team of portfolio management professionals.

Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement while advancing portfolio management capabilities across the enterprise.

Champion organizational change management and PMO best practices to improve adoption, efficiency, and business outcomes.

What We Seek:

Demonstrated success leading an Enterprise PMO, Portfolio Management Office, or comparable function within a complex global organization.

Extensive experience managing strategic technology portfolios, enterprise transformation initiatives, and portfolio governance processes.

Strong expertise in demand management, prioritization, resource planning, investment management, and value realization.

Deep understanding of portfolio, program, project, Agile, and product delivery methodologies.

Proven ability to influence executive decision-making and build strong partnerships across business and technology functions.

Strong business and financial acumen, including business case development, budgeting, forecasting, and investment planning.

Demonstrated success leading organizational change, improving operating models, and driving measurable business outcomes.

Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Broad understanding of enterprise business processes and supporting technologies across key functional areas.

Outstanding Candidates Will Have:

Master's degree in business administration, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

10+ years of progressive leadership experience in portfolio, program, or project management.

title: Senior Accessibility Program Manager
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

At GitHub, our mission is to accelerate human progress through developer collaboration. We believe people with disabilities should benefit from that progress and directly contribute to the creation of it. 

 

We are seeking a forward-thinking, determined and innovative individual, who is passionate about the intersection of accessibility and technology, to help implement our accessibility strategy, which can be found at accessibility.github.com. This role will report directly to the Head of Accessibility and will be empowered to drive change internally and externally. 

 

 The successful candidate will:

  • Have a deep understanding of accessibility, assistive technologies, and the ways that people with disabilities interact with technology.
  • Have technical expertise that is grounded in professional experience as a software developer or designer.
  • Have hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve accessibility at scale.
  • Have professional experience managing accessibility initiatives within a large matrixed organization.
  • Have a proven track record of delivering results that empower people with disabilities to use technology. 

Responsibilities

 The goals of the GitHub accessibility program are to: 

  • Empower GitHub employees to do the best work of their lives by creating an accessible work environment with internal guides and support for procurement processes.

  • Empower developers with disabilities to build on GitHub by including their input throughout the development process, cultivating a culture of accessibility within GitHub, and driving accountability at scale.

  • Empower our customers to meet their accessibility goals when building on GitHub by aggressively dogfooding the latest GitHub platform and AI features to run our internal accessibility program, Open-sourcing our internal tools when appropriate, and sharing best practices externally.

  • Help improve the accessibility of open source by empowering people with disabilities to contribute, improving the availability and adoption of open-source Assistive Technologies, and improving the accessibility of mainstream open-source projects. 

The Senior Accessibility Program Manager may contribute to all of those program goals over time. That said, their initial focus will include, but is not limited to:

  • Manage listening systems including inclusive user research and feedback processes.
  • Build an accessibility community of practice within our Enterprise customer community.
  • Grow the capabilities of the open-source GitHub accessibility scanner and accelerate adoption by customers and open-source communities. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications :

  • 7+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area 

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications/Marketing, or related field AND 5+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area 

    • OR Master's Degree in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications/Marketing, or related field AND 3+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area

    • OR Doctorate in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications/Marketing, or related field AND 1+ year(s) experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area

    • OR equivalent experience

  • 3+ years of relevant experience driving programs or initiatives across organizational boundaries in a large organization.
  • 3+ years of experience evaluating the conformance of web content against the Web Content Accessibility guidelines.
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve accessibility at scale. 

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing accessible web-based user interfaces using JavaScript and modern web technologies.
  • Experience collecting and interpreting data for performance metrics and compliance.
  • Understanding of product road mapping and experience working with product and engineering teams to embed new features into roadmap plans. 

We encourage people with lived experience to apply. 


Compensation Range

The base salary range for this job is USD $103,200.00 - USD $273,700.00 /Yr.

These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.

This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

GitHub is seeking a detail-oriented individual contributor with a technical bent and experience in technical risk management who is driven to deepen that expertise. GitHub is committed to doing right by our customers and developing a highly effective control environment where risk is managed in a meaningful and sensible way that aligns with our business. 

  • Do you love the challenge of diving into the details and learning why and how things work? 

  • Do you find yourself always asking what would have to go wrong, and how badly? 

  • Do you want to see The Big Picture, and find ways to collect and organize data to tell the story? 

  • Do you suffer from a compulsive need to document things and “get it down on paper”? 

  • And last, but most certainly not least, have you already answered the question “Why are we here?” with the GRC Truth, “Because Customers”? 

 

If so, you might be the person we are looking for! 

 

As part of GRC’s Entity Risk function, you will join the Technical Risk team and partner with engineering, security, and product subject-matter experts and leaders across GitHub to conduct capability risk assessments, develop and quantify risk scenarios, and deliver meaningful risk reporting that helps leaders make risk-informed decisions. 

Central to the team's culture is that of inclusion, transparency, and teamwork - we lift each other up to be successful! This is an excellent opportunity for an independent contributor to have a hand in elevating risk management and security as business and sales enabler as well as integrate a deeper understanding of risk management into the product and business space. 


Responsibilities

  • Lead security capability risk assessments for assigned areas, including scoping against NIST CSF subcategories, coordinating schedules and stakeholder interviews, completing maturity scoring, and publishing assessment reports. 

  • Analyze data from multiple sources to identify, analyze, and prioritize technical risks, develop and quantify FAIR-style cyber risk scenarios, evaluate capabilities against established frameworks, and assess potential impacts to GitHub – our products, services, customers, and business objectives. 

  • Partner with engineering, security, and product subject-matter experts and leaders to validate findings, identify risk patterns, and translate technical insights and stakeholder feedback into practical risk recommendations. 

  • Develop and manage risk treatment plans, drive adoption of appropriate mitigations and remediation, monitor treatment progress, and escalate unresolved or emerging risks. 

  • Maintain the risk register and supporting records in GitHub’s GRC system of record, track mitigation progress, and provide clear, recurring risk updates to technical and non-technical leaders. 

 


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 7+ years experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, software engineering, or relevant area; 

    • o OR Associate's Degree AND 6+ years experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, software engineering, or relevant area
    • o OR Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, software engineering, or relevant area
    • o OR Master's Degree AND 3+ years experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, software engineering, or relevant area
    • o OR Doctorate AND 1+ year(s) experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, software engineering, or relevant area
    • o OR equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years experience applying security or control frameworks, such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, or ISO/IEC 27001. 

  • 5+ years experience in technical risk management, information security, audit, or compliance. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience applying cyber risk quantification (CRQ) using FAIR or a comparable quantitative risk analysis method, including developing risk scenarios and estimating loss event frequency and loss magnitude to produce defensible loss exposure ranges that express risk in financial terms and support risk-informed investment and risk-acceptance decisions.  

  • Experience with GRC platforms used to maintain risk registers and risk treatment plans (ZenGRC, ServiceNow GRC, Archer, or comparable). 

  • Experience building risk reporting, metrics, or automation using Azure Data Explorer (Kusto/KQL), Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, Python, or comparable tools. 

  • Experience translating security and compliance requirements between business stakeholders and technical engineering or operations teams. 

  • CISSP, CRISC, CISA, Open FAIR, or a comparable independent certification.

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Overview

GitHub helps companies and organizations succeed by allowing them to build better software, together. We're looking for an experienced Senior Solutions Engineer in the United States to provide technical presales support for our enterprise customer base — in regulated industries, particularly financial services and healthcare.   

 

Our Senior Solutions Engineers are responsible for the technical relationships with customers and prospects, working as a trusted advisor to remove technical objections and creatively address pain points in a customer's SDLC. They will work internally with sales and product development teams to identify solutions that meet customers' business needs and document requests to expand the capabilities of GitHub's platform.  

 

We're extremely passionate about the quality of our work. If you are technically sharp, business minded, and people oriented, you might be a fit for this role! 


Responsibilities

  • Identifying customer business & technical requirements and matching them to product solutions. 

  • Building joint customer strategies with enterprise sales, support, and customer success to encourage product adoption. 

  • Delivering live demonstrations of GitHub’s products and platform to prospective customers.  

  • Navigating complex technical scenarios to help customers migrate to GitHub from their existing development tools and workflows.  

  • Building relationships with key decision makers and serving as a customer's technical point of contact and advocate.  

  • Learning about customers' successes and challenges, sharing customer feedback within GitHub, and advocating for customer interests.  

  • Applying understanding of customer environment and goals to provide oversight and guide post-sales teams to successful outcomes.

    • Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) architecture, tools and workflows

    • Agentic software development practices and tools.

About the Team

The Data Center Build and Delivery team develops the infrastructure that supports OpenAI’s research and products. We work with engineering, construction partners and Operations to deliver safe, reliable facilities at scale. As our portfolio grows, consistent health, safety and environmental practices and clear performance measures help teams identify risks early and deliver sites that are ready to operate.

About the Role

We are looking for an HSE and Portfolio Performance Lead to strengthen health, safety and environmental oversight and performance management across our data center construction portfolio. You will help sites meet applicable OSHA standards and other HSE requirements, from construction through commissioning and handoff to Operations.

You will work across site teams, delivery partners and central functions to establish practical expectations, verify execution and turn portfolio data into action. This role combines hands-on HSE expertise with a portfolio view of contractor performance, risk and operational readiness.

Key Responsibilities

Develop a consistent portfolio HSE framework covering contractor expectations, risk assessments, field verification, training and escalation, aligned with OpenAI’s EHS standards and relevant specialists.

Translate applicable OSHA construction and general-industry requirements into practical site expectations, verify implementation and clarify responsibilities as work transitions from construction to commissioning and Operations.

Partner with site and discipline leaders to assess high-risk work, verify critical controls and escalate unsafe conditions, including electrical energization, hazardous energy, lifting, excavation and concurrent construction and operating activities.

Establish portfolio performance measures and reporting for HSE outcomes, contractor performance, corrective-action closure and handoff readiness; align definitions with delivery and Operations teams and validate data quality.

Lead cross-site performance reviews to identify recurring risks, compare execution against agreed expectations and drive improvement plans with accountable owners, milestones and follow-through.

Plan risk-based site assurance and contractor reviews, support incident and near-miss investigations, verify corrective actions and embed lessons learned across the portfolio.

Coordinate environmental compliance with site teams and specialists, including waste management, spill prevention, stormwater controls and relevant permit obligations.

Define HSE readiness criteria for operational handoff with commissioning and Operations teams, including training, procedures, emergency preparedness, outstanding risks and transfer of required records.

Provide clear portfolio updates and recommendations to leadership, surface decisions and resource needs early, and build consistent safety leadership across employees, developers, contractors and service providers.

Qualifications

Substantial experience leading HSE programs for major construction or complex industrial projects, including oversight across multiple sites or workstreams and responsibility for contractor performance.

Working knowledge of applicable OSHA construction and general-industry standards, with experience translating requirements into site controls and verifying implementation across construction, commissioning and operating interfaces.

Practical understanding of data center or complex industrial hazards, including electrical safety, hazardous-energy control and high-risk construction activities.

Demonstrated ability to build assurance, performance reporting and corrective-action programs and use leading and lagging indicators to improve outcomes.

Experience coordinating contractors, site leaders and functional specialists through commissioning and operational handoff, with clear accountability across organizational boundaries.

Strong communication and judgment, with the ability to explain technical risk, influence leaders and field teams, and prioritize action in fast-changing environments.

Preferred Skills

Experience with owner-side HSE oversight across a data center or mission-critical infrastructure portfolio, including developer-led and self-build delivery models.

Experience integrating environmental compliance, emergency preparedness and HSE management systems into construction and operational readiness programs.

Relevant professional credentials, such as CSP, CIH or an equivalent safety or environmental qualification, or comparable practical expertise.

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

Job Summary:

As a Senior Product Manager - Operations, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of Radiant’s internal tooling and integrations, helping teams operate and scale the cloud platform efficiently.

You’ll work across CMDB, asset and service inventory, internal APIs, workflow automation, third-party integrations, and platform administration, partnering closely with engineering, SRE, infrastructure, networking, security, and operations.

This is a highly technical product role focused on reducing operational friction, improving self-service, and creating reliable, scalable internal systems.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of internal tooling, CMDB, service catalogues, operational workflows, and integrations.

  • Translate business and operational needs into clear product requirements, specs, user stories, data models, and priorities.

  • Partner with engineering to define solutions across APIs, integrations, automation, and platform tooling.

  • Work with SRE, infrastructure, security, support, and other internal users to identify pain points and improve automation and self-service.

  • Establish reliable sources of truth for infrastructure, services, customers, environments, ownership, and configuration.

  • Drive prioritisation, backlog management, technical design discussions, delivery, and adoption.

  • Define success metrics and ensure tooling is secure, observable, auditable, reliable, and well documented.

  • Evaluate build vs. buy decisions and third-party tooling where appropriate.

Qualifications:

  • Experience owning technical products, internal platforms, developer tooling, or infrastructure products end-to-end.

  • Experience working across data centre operations, hardware lifecycle and inventory, infrastructure support, field operations, or adjacent operational environments.

  • Strong technical fluency across:

    • APIs & integrations: REST, gRPC, webhooks, third-party APIs

    • Infrastructure: Kubernetes, cloud platforms, containers, infrastructure-as-code

    • Data & CMDB: relational modelling, inventory, ownership, dependency mapping

    • Automation: queues, schedulers, workflow engines, event-driven systems

    • Observability & security: logging, metrics, tracing, IAM, RBAC, audit logging

  • Familiarity with tools such as NetBox, ServiceNow, Terraform, Grafana, Jira, or similar.

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts including retries, idempotency, eventual consistency, and failure handling.

  • Strong prioritisation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Comfortable working closely with engineers and making informed technical trade-offs without needing to be the primary implementer.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and taking ambiguous problems from discovery through to delivery.

What you bring:

  • Systems thinking: Understand how infrastructure, services, data, and operational workflows fit together.

  • Product thinking: Treat internal teams as customers and focus on measurable outcomes.

  • Technical fluency: Able to work credibly across APIs, integrations, infrastructure, data, and architecture.

Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.
