Job ID: 10586385 | Amazon.com Services LLC

Apply now

Description

The Energy Analytics, Technical Program Manager (TPM) will scale power monitoring, insight generation, and energy and carbon reduction initiatives across Amazon's North America fulfillment operations. In this hands-on technical role, you will deploy and generate analysis from power metering infrastructure and implement load flexibility and energy optimization roadmaps that deliver measurable cost savings and carbon reductions. This work directly supports Amazon's demand-side power requirements and Climate Pledge commitments.

You will operate as an individual contributor, owning the delivery of defined and ambiguous work-streams while partnering with engineering, controls, data, operations and deployment teams to implement changes. You will influence cross-functional partners without authority, primarily at the team and management level, using data to drive decisions. You will integrate and analyze power metering information, providing load forecasts and generating cost and energy savings opportunities. Utility rate structures, time of day, demand ratchets and power factor penalties will influence your strategies. Technical assets influenced can include material handling, robotics, powered industrial trucks, lighting, heating ventilation and air conditioning, plug loads, electrical metering and more. Developed projects will be scaled across hundreds of facilities across the network, producing energy, cost and carbon benefit.

Key job responsibilities

● Build and execute technical solutions for energy and carbon reduction from pilot, data collection, through scaled implementation and measurement & verification (M&V) of results.  Energy and load optimization via control systems is a technical requirement: energy-conservation/standby modes, variable speed applications, and equipment scheduling.

● Drive continuous monitoring and energy efficiency improvements with Amazon's energy consuming assets.  Integrate power metering into our data sets, and develop analytics to identify opportunities, assess trending consumption changes, and measure benefits of conservation efforts.

● Prepare written analysis of feasibility studies and recommendations for various energy monitoring and power flexibility strategies.  Own metering data quality programs, check readings for completeness, outliers, and flag actionable improvements, and reconcile against known loads to ensure trusted insight generation.

● Develop metrics, baselines, and roadmaps that translate technical work into quantified outcomes (energy savings, cost savings or utility tariff arbitrage, load forecast, reliability, carbon reduction).

● Define and own technical approach and cross-system architecture for data configuration, standards and mechanisms for scalability and enforcement of key energy savings mechanisms. Decide how to build and prove new approaches managing tradeoffs for necessary business needs, rather than executing a defined scope.

● Manage projects against plans and objectives to ensure commitments are met, delivering against our power and Climate Pledge goals.

● Deep diving (troubleshooting) and unblocking issues that are prohibiting teams from pursuing energy reduction initiatives.

● Work with critical stakeholders on developing mechanisms for design standard integration for launching facilities that incorporate energy optimization procedures from Day 1.

● Analyze and communicate the financial impact of projects and initiatives (payback, return on investment, net present value)

● Serve as a technical reviewer for peers and partner engineers — reviewing control logic, metering architecture, and design-standard changes, and improving them on technical merit

● Quantify and own value add of energy savings mechanisms and how they reduce equipment runtime and increases reliability and lifespan.

● Calculate and report energy, water and carbon savings using International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol methodologies.

● Manage multiple, complex projects simultaneously.

● Produce clear documentation, playbooks, and reporting that make work-streams repeatable.

A day in the life

You might spend the morning querying newly integrated power-metering data and validating it against the distribution-panel hierarchy — resolving a data-quality gap — then analyzing load profiles and build an energy-savings or peak-shaving model that quantifies the opportunity by equipment class. You then define network rollout suitability and prioritize these opportunities across sites. In the afternoon you develop control logic changes to implement an efficiency opportunity, propose updates to a design standard, or define a measurement method for implemented energy and cost savings to your stakeholders. You balance trade-offs between energy savings, technical complexity, equipment reliability, and cost — bringing well-reasoned recommendations and escalating the most ambiguous decisions for alignment.

About the team

The Global Energy, Sustainability and Automation (GESA) Energy team is dedicated to delivering energy efficiency, cost savings, and demand flexibility within Amazon's fulfillment network. We partner closely with design, controls, data, procurement, operations, field engineering, and deployment teams — as well as external vendors — to ensure our energy consumption is monitored and optimized. Our focus in the coming years is scaling our energy monitoring and analytics programs, expanding behavioral and retrofit programs, expanding load flexibility for power resilience and cost arbitrage benefit, and enhancing asset reliability and lifespan through efficient operation. If you are energized by large-scale technical challenges and want to make a tangible impact on energy use, this is the team for you.

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

- Experience in SQL Server/MySQL, or experience in Redshift and experience in any Bigdata architecture

- Experience working with existing and emerging technologies related to building energy (i.e. power metering, conveyance, robotics, controls, HVAC, charging infrastructure)

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing cross-functional programs and release schedules

- Familiarity with automation engineering and controls engineering concepts.

- Industry certifications: Certified Energy Manager, Certified Measurement & Verification Professional, Professional Engineer.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager on the PGS leadership team, you will report directly to the Head of Power Generation Solutions and serve as a strategic partner to PGS and Global Energy leadership. This is a dual-scope role: you will own technical program management for one of PGS's power programs, while also driving cross-cutting strategy, controllership, and operational mechanisms for PGS and the broader Global Energy organization.

You will work at the intersection of technical execution and business strategy, partnering with PGS engineering leads, Global Energy Principals, Energy Portfolio Operations, Finance, and senior AWS leadership to ensure our programs are on track, our organization is scaled appropriately, and our strategy is clear and actionable. You'll engage external partners, facilitate senior executive interactions, and serve as a trusted voice for PGS in cross-organizational forums.

This role is right for someone who thrives in ambiguity, thinks big, and can operate with equal fluency in a technical design review and a VP-level strategy session.

About You

You have a track record of delivering complex, ambiguous programs at scale — and doing it with the business acumen and executive presence to bring senior leaders along. You are data-driven but not data-bound; you know when to go deep and when to synthesize. You write clearly, speak directly, and earn trust quickly across organizational boundaries.

You are energized by consequential work. AWS's power strategy is shaping how the world's infrastructure gets built — and this role sits at the center of it.

Basic Qualifications

Experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with senior leadership visibility

Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to translate data into strategic recommendations

Excellent written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing materials for VP-level audiences

Key job responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Own technical program management for part of the AWS power program, including pipeline management, milestone tracking, senior leader engagement, and vendor coordination.

Partner with the Head of PGS to develop and maintain a multi-year strategic roadmap for Global Energy, translating long-term priorities into annual execution plans with clear owners and accountability mechanisms.

Lead Global Energy controllership mechanisms, including headcount and resource planning, hiring performance tracking, and operating cadence — ensuring leadership has timely, accurate visibility into organizational health and delivery status.

Develop and manage reporting for senior leadership on program status, strategic initiatives, and organizational metrics; synthesize complex inputs into clear, decision-ready narratives.

Build and maintain trusted relationships with Finance, Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, and partner delivery organizations to ensure Global Energy's full scope of needs is represented in cross-organizational planning.

Drive continuous improvement in Global Energy's operating mechanisms — identifying gaps, proposing solutions, and leading implementation across teams.

Represent PGS and Global Energy in senior forums, including facilitating off-sites, leadership reviews, and partner engagements inside and outside AWS.

Champion a high-performance team culture: model strong judgment, clear communication, and a bias for action.

About the team

The Power Generation Solutions team creates and delivers product and engineering solutions in for power and energy to help advance AWS’ mission to deliver world-leading cloud services. Our solutions are guided by four main principles; unlocking capacity growth, maintaining high infrastructure uptime, minimizing infrastructure costs, and advancing our net-zero carbon Climate Pledge. To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We also provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance. 

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience

- Experience working in a program management capacity and/or leading large-scale complex projects

- Experience providing and effectively communicating strategic and tactical recommendations based on data

- Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders

- 7+ years of experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

Preferred Qualifications

- MBA, or Advanced degree

- Experience in energy, power generation, or data center infrastructure

- Familiarity with nuclear energy development, permitting, or procurement processes

- Experience in organizational planning, headcount modeling, or operational controllership

SQA Integration TPM

Description -

We are seeking a technically strong, highly motivated Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our Software Quality organization.

The ideal candidate combines a solid software engineering background with strong analytical skills, technical program management experience, and hands-on expertise in AI and automation.

We are particularly interested in individuals who embrace emerging technologies, challenge traditional ways of working, and can independently develop AI-powered tools and solutions to improve engineering efficiency and effectiveness.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

- Strong technical background in software development, firmware, software quality, or systems engineering.

- Experience working with complex software systems and cross-functional engineering teams.

- Solid understanding of software development lifecycles, CI/CD, version control, software testing, and quality engineering practices.

- Experience with Jira, Git, Jenkins, or comparable engineering tools.

- Strong scripting or programming skills, preferably Python.

- Hands-on experience with generative AI, LLMs, and AI-powered automation.

- Ability to design, develop, and integrate AI agents, bots, and automated workflows using APIs and modern AI frameworks.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex technical information.

- Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to work independently, influence cross-functional teams, and drive technical decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with embedded software, Android, Linux, or connected devices.

- Background in software integration, SDET, DevOps, or release engineering.

- Familiarity with AI agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel.

- Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool calling, RAG, and multi-agent workflows.

- Experience integrating AI solutions with engineering platforms and development tools.

- Knowledge of automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and software quality metrics.

- Experience applying AI to software development, testing, debugging, or engineering productivity.

- Prior technical program management or technical leadership experience.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We value candidates who are:

Technically hands-on: Comfortable understanding code, troubleshooting technical issues, and building practical solutions.

AI-native: Actively using AI in their daily work and capable of creating agents and bots, not simply writing prompts.

Analytical: Able to assess complex technical problems and make sound, evidence-based decisions.

Proactive: Identify opportunities for improvement and take ownership without waiting for instructions.

Influential: Confident working with experienced engineers and technical leaders.

Adaptable: Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving technologies and priorities.- 

The pay range for this role is $105,050 to $161,800 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure

11 paid holidays

title: Engineering Technician III – Senior CNC Programmer – 5-Axis Milling
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.
 

SUMMARY

This role develops, launches and sustains complex CNC milling processes, independently delivering safe, capable, compliant and cost-effective solutions.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Independently owns complete multi-axis milling solutions from manufacturability review through CAD/CAM programming, post processing, machine setup, prove-out, FAI, validation, release and production.

Programs and optimizes complex 3-, 4- and 5-axis milling processes using advanced G/M code, Macro B and Siemens and/or Fanuc control language; diagnoses complete process and machine issues.

Leads CNC activities for new-product and process improvements; Delivers on schedule, quality, capacity and cost targets with minimal intervention or rework.

Provides expert hands-on troubleshooting and failure analysis for CNC mills and related automation, probing, laser tool-setting and multi-axis systems.

Develops and implements cutting-tool, holder and fixture strategies; demonstrates advanced tool/fixture design capability and collaborates effectively with designers, suppliers and equipment builders.

Drives equipment requirements, machine selection, vendor acceptance, installation, alignment and qualification; independently interfaces with vendors and contributes technical recommendations to site and customer manufacturing discussions.

Establishes and shares CAD/CAM and machining best practices, delivers meaningful cost and productivity improvements, and formally mentors lower-level technicians, programmers and operators.

Partners across Engineering, Operations and Maintenance; prioritize multiple assignments, communicates technical decisions and completes projects on time and with high quality.

Acts as a role model for Machine Operators in terms of attitude, machine asset care, troubleshooting, adherence to processes and decision making.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Associate’s degree or equivalent technical certification preferred; equivalent combination of education and experience considered.

4+ years of advanced CNC programming required, including significate experience with 5-axis milling.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS REQUIREMENTS

Subject-matter-expert-level ability to take complex 5-axis surface milled components from concept through stable production using 5-axis milling best practices.

Experience deploying processes with machine probing, parametric programming, and machine calculations.

Advanced CAD/CAM proficiency, including 3D model preparation, geometry repair, fixture modeling, and toolpath generation.

Advanced Mastercam programming and multi-axis toolpath development required.

Proficiency with Fanuc ISO G/M and/or Siemens programming languages.

Proficiency with interpreting technical drawings and GD&T.

CMM data interpretation, use of complex manual gaging.

Expert troubleshooting, mentoring, technical leadership, and cross-functional collaboration.

Working knowledge of Macro B programming preferred.

Proficiency with Fanuc Robodrill and/or DMG DMP70 machining platforms preferred.

Experience integrating CNC equipment with automation systems, robotic loading, pallet systems, and machine-to-machine communication preferred.

The NPI Technical Program Manager (TPM) is an individual contributor role in the Common Solutions Group (CSG) responsible for driving new products from design maturity through transfer to high-volume manufacturing. You will own the integrated program plan, milestones, dependencies, and risk management while leading cross-functional partners across engineering, operations, materials, and manufacturing engineering. 

Success in this role requires strong communication, structured problem-solving, and the ability to remove roadblocks, drive decisions, and keep the team aligned to quality, time-to-market, and cost objectives.

Applied Materials is the world leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world.

This NPI TPM position is in the Common Solutions Group (CSG) which supports all business units. The TPM is a strategic facilitator and has both strategic and execution responsibilities within a matrix organization on multiple product lines.

This is an IC role where a drive for excellence and a sense of urgency connects design and manufacturing. The TPM is the “air traffic controller” that leads a matrix team of New Product Manufacturing Engineers (NPMEs), Material Project Managers (MPMs) and NPI Operations to mature the product and transfer it into high volume manufacturing. By finding and fixing issues proactively, the TPM ensures the team and the product meets Quality/Functionality, Time to Market and Cost objectives.

Critical skills for the role include capacity for complexity, agility, requirements gathering, critical thinking, stakeholder management, change management, risk management and excellent communication.

Additional skills and experience for this job include Systems Thinking, Organizational Change Management, Business Process Management, Lean, resource capacity and capability planning, predictive (waterfall) and agile project management, tolerance of ambiguity, influencing without direct authority and influencing team engagement.

Key Responsibilities

Program plan development and ownership: Establish the strategy, plan, and schedule; define and track milestones; break down deliverables and assign owners; map dependencies; identify and respond to changes and risks.

Program stakeholder management: Align scope and requirements, drive weekly/biweekly cross-functional cadence, exec reviews, decision logs, and drive escalations to closure.

Program execution: Remove roadblocks and drive completion to the plan. Adapt to changes. Assess readiness for transition to High Volume Manufacturing and enable the transfer of responsibilities. Forecast capacity and integration into manufacturing strategy.

Organizational growth: Conduct lessons learned and integrate into business process improvements.

Description

Prime Air is seeking a Technical Program Manager to drive airworthiness certification programs for the MK30 unmanned aircraft system. You will own the plans, schedules, and compliance tracking that turn certification strategy into execution. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and regulatory compliance. You will coordinate across software, hardware, systems, and test teams to keep certification deliverables on track and surface risks early.

A key dimension of this role is international regulatory coordination. Prime Air operates across multiple countries, each with its own aviation authority and certification expectations. You will manage the programs that drive international approvals of the drone system. You will track regulatory deltas across jurisdictions and maximize reuse of compliance evidence, so each country is not run as a separate program.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Engineering Certification.

Key job responsibilities

Own the plans, schedules, and compliance matrices for Prime Air's certification programs across DO-178C (software), DO-254 (hardware), and DO-160G (environmental qualification).

Track certification objectives against engineering deliverables. Identify gaps and dependencies early, and drive them to closure.

Partner with engineering teams to sequence certification work within the development lifecycle. Escalate schedule and resource risks to leadership.

Build and maintain the status reporting, metrics, and dashboards that give leadership visibility into certification progress

Coordinate the programs that support regulatory engagement across the markets Prime Air operates in (EASA, CASA, DGCA, CAA, JCAB, and others).

Track regulatory requirements and deltas across authorities. Manage the evidence reuse plan that supports bilateral validation processes (for example, FAA-to-EASA) to reduce international approval timelines.

Monitor emerging regulations (for example, EU U-Space, FAA BVLOS rulemaking) and fold new requirements into program plans before they become blockers.

Drive alignment across engineering, regulatory, and certification teams on scope, milestones, and means of compliance.

Support the Senior Manager and certification engineers in preparing compliance arguments and documentation for the FAA, EASA, and international DERs/CVEs.

Establish and improve the program mechanisms that scale certification delivery as Prime Air expands internationally.

About the team

This is a new organization within Prime Air to own the technical execution of certification to support our world-wide expansion focus in 2027 and beyond.

Description

The Technical Infrastructure Program Manager II (TIPM II) within Data Center Infrastructure Engineering (DCIE) manages cross-functional infrastructure programs across Amazon Fulfillment and Logistics operations worldwide. This role operates primarily tactically while growing strategically — owning end-to-end program execution and adapting deployment plans to varying site and regional scenarios within a defined program strategy.

The TIPM II drives collaboration across engineering, operations, vendors, finance, and field teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and cost-effective infrastructure. This includes owning program performance metrics, infrastructure health dashboards, and reporting (MBRs, QBRs, OP narratives) that give stakeholders visibility into program impact, risks, and investment justification.

This role requires the ability to work independently and seek guidance as needed, adapt deployment plans where templates do not fully fit, coordinate resources and priorities across teams, and find paths forward in difficult situations — while beginning to mentor peers and improve team and project processes.

Key job responsibilities

Program Strategy & Execution

- Own end-to-end execution of cross-functional infrastructure programs; define scope and success criteria within the program's established strategy

- Deliver in environments where deployment plans may need modification from defined templates; coordinate resources and priorities across teams

- Manage scope, risk, and time vs. cost trade-offs across program delivery

Program Reporting & Performance Metrics

- Own program KPIs (uptime, power efficiency, deployment cycle times, cost per deployment)

- Build and maintain dashboards; recognize when deployment issues stem from technical design gaps and raise them to engineering

Reporting & Business Reviews

- Own OP1/OP2 narratives, MBRs, QBRs, and risk reports for your programs

- Present program status and recommendations to management and senior leadership

Risk Management & Compliance

- Identify and mitigate risks impacting execution; partner with DPM on escalations and deviation approvals

- Work with infrastructure engineering teams to address audit failures

Process Improvement

- Improve project and cross-team process efficiency; create more predictable delivery paths

Stakeholder Communication & Leadership

- Act as the interface between engineering, operations, vendors, and management

- Build consensus across differing views; begin mentoring peers and contractors

A day in the life

Your day starts reviewing infrastructure health dashboards and overnight ticket trends to identify issues or opportunities. You'll lead morning syncs with engineers and SysDevs to align on milestones, unblock deliverables, and escalate risks. Midday, you collaborate with vendors and partner teams on deployment schedules or supply chain constraints. Afternoons involve deep dives on program metrics or preparing status updates for business reviews. You close out by refining milestone progress, intake priorities, or supporting peers on program delivery — all while helping shape infrastructure direction across thousands of Amazon FCs.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits for you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

The Data Center Infrastructure Engineering (DCIE) team within Ops Technology Infrastructure Engineering (OTIE) designs, standardizes, and sustains scalable, cost-effective, and resilient IT infrastructure for Amazon Fulfillment and Logistics Operations worldwide. We enable Operations Technology Solutions (OTS) by delivering high-performance power, cooling, structured cabling, edge compute, and automation solutions that ensure reliable and efficient on-premises hardware operations.

Our work spans Demarcation Rooms, MDFs, IDFs, power systems (UPSs, ATSs, PDUs), fault-managed power, cooling and containment, Computers on Wheels (COWs), telecommunications, and distributed edge compute infrastructure to enhance data processing and reduce latency.

Through automation, predictive data assessment, and proactive maintenance, DCIE drives operational excellence, minimizes downtime, and scales infrastructure to support Amazon's rapid growth while aligning with its efficiency, reliability & safety, sustainability, and scalability goals.

The Amazon Leo Electronic Supply Chain team is seeking an Operations Technical Program Manager to drive technical manufacturing and supply chain operations for Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBA) destined for our satellites. The successful candidate will manage contract manufacturers' end-to-end production processes and work with internal customers like design and reliability engineering while maintaining a focus on quality and delivery requirements.

As an Operations TPM at Amazon Leo, you'll start your day reviewing upcoming deliveries, blockers and constraints, and production metrics across your contract manufacturers. It’s a new Day 1 for Leo, and we are looking for team members to join the Accounting PMO supporting this emerging business.

You operate effectively in a fast-paced, global, results-oriented environment. Strong oral and written communication skills are essential, along with the ability to think clearly, analyze quantitatively, problem-solve, scope business requirements, and prioritize.

Successful candidates bring experience across three disciplines: Accounting, Program Management, and Financial Systems Implementation. You contribute to cross-functional decision-making and help drive implementation across a global scope, balancing time to market with investments in automation.

Our Finance team serves as a trusted partner to the business, providing the financial perspective leaders need to make informed decisions. title: Technical Program Manager, Science Operations, Code
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to partner with Mistral's code and vibe research team - the researchers shaping how our models write, reason about, and play with code. You'll be their operational counterpart - the person who absorbs what the team is working on and makes it legible to the team, to leadership, and to adjacent teams.

This isn't a coordination role. It's a research partnership role - embedded with the team, fluent in what they're building, and operationally responsible for everything that isn't the science itself.

The ideal candidate is someone who is genuinely excited about code models. You play with them. You have opinions about what makes them feel good to use. You read the papers because you want to, not because you have to. A research background is a plus but not required - what matters is that you care about this domain and can hold your own in a room full of researchers working on it.

 

What will you do

  • Research Visibility: Partner with the team to maintain a shared, accessible view of their ongoing work - what's in flight, where it's heading, what's ready to hand off. Make the research legible to adjacent teams and leadership without pulling researchers into status work.

  • Operational Partnership: Be the team's operational partner. Handle the coordination, resourcing, and cross-team conversations that would otherwise sit on researchers' plates - so the team can stay focused on the science.

  • Research-to-release: Own the operational path from research work to release candidate for code and vibe workstreams. Partner with the release function to ensure the team's work flows cleanly into Mistral's release machinery.

  • Visibility & Communication Cadence: Code and vibe research connects to many other efforts across the organization. Keep these interfaces clean and high-signal, so the team's work integrates naturally with the wider science org.

  • Strategic Communication: Translate the team's work into clear, well-timed updates for leadership and adjacent teams - what's being built, what matters, what's coming next.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Genuine enthusiasm for code models and coding assistants - you play with them, push them, have opinions about them

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 3+ years of experience in technical program management, operations, or research coordination

  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable working in ambiguity and shaping it into structure

  • Ability to engage substantively with research work and build real credibility with technical teams

  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate technical detail into clarity for different audiences


Nice to have criteria/ would be ideal if you have/are:

 

  • Experience in research-heavy or ML/AI organizations

  • Familiarity with code generation, coding agents, software engineering benchmarks, or related research areas

  • Hands-on experience with modern coding tools - you're a user, not just an observer

  • Track record of building systemic processes from the ground up

  • Comfort working in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments where priorities shift quickly

 

Why Join Us?

  • Shape how frontier AI is built and released: You’ll design and operate the systems that connect scientific discovery to real-world deployment - ensuring our work scales with clarity, reliability, and speed

  • Work inside the Science OS: Join a team building the operational backbone of Mistral’s science organization - where structure meets creativity and processes evolve through use, not bureaucracy

  • Drive visible, high-leverage impact: Your work will sit at the intersection of research, engineering, and leadership - turning complexity into alignment and enabling confident, data-informed decisions across the company

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

About Ampirical

At Ampirical, we're shaping the future of the power grid with precision, innovation, and purpose. Just as the ampere is the foundation of electric current, Ampirical is a core force driving the energy sector forward. We focus on quality, forward-thinking solutions, and empowering our team to grow and thrive.

We don’t just build projects—we build careers. If you’re looking for a place where your contributions matter and your professional development is supported every step of the way, we’d love to meet you. Watch this video to get a glimpse into our culture.

Why Ampirical?

💰 Salary Range: $150,000+ - Commensurate (dependent on experience, education, and qualifications)

🩺 Day-One Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision
💼 401(k) with 4% match and immediate vesting
🏖️ PTO: Starting at 80 hours of vacation & 40 hours of sick time per year + 10 paid holidays
🗓️ Flexible Work Schedule: Every other Friday off

PMO Department Overview:

The Engineering PMO Department provides Project Management and Contract compliance with structure and oversight that support Ampirical’s engineering teams in delivering high-quality power delivery projects. The department manages proposals, scope, schedule, budget, and risk while ensuring compliance with contractual, regulatory, and industry standards. Serving as a central hub for coordination, communication, and project controls, the PMO drives consistency, accountability, and smooth execution across all engineering projects.

Your Role: Engineering Program Manager

Ampirical's Engineering PMO is seeking an Engineering Program Manager to manage the engineering contract scope for a portfolio of related projects and task orders, typically in the $1M to $5M range, across multiple engineering disciplines. Coordinates scope, schedule, budget, risk, and resources across the portfolio and oversees engineering deliverables to confirm they meet client contract requirements, applicable codes, and the standard of care. Serves as a program-level contact for clients and stakeholders, supports proposal development and contract negotiation, including Master Service Agreements (MSAs), and mentors project managers and engineering staff on program management practices.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage contract scope, budget, schedule, resources, and risk for a portfolio of multi-discipline engineering projects and task orders; prepare monthly status reports covering scope, risk, schedule, budget, and resources.

  • Develop and maintain engineering budgets (bottom-up with top-down comparison and market value analysis), milestone schedules, and resource plans; align scheduling and performance reporting across projects to program goals.

  • Review and negotiate client, subconsultant, and MSA terms and conditions with the legal team; maintain risk registers; administer milestones, deliverables, and change orders.

  • Oversee engineering deliverables for quality, code compliance, and standard of care; ensure project safety plans, quality assurance plans, and environmental, land use, and permitting requirements are met, including engineering seal requirements.

  • Lead competitive bids and qualifications for multi-discipline proposals, including MSAs; support business development and capture activities for larger opportunities.

  • Serve as the program-level contact for clients and stakeholders; lead meetings, resolve cross-project conflicts, manage expectations, and plan and lead site visits and field coordination as needed.

  • Mentor project managers and engineering staff, support onboarding and training, and promote best practices and lessons learned across projects.

What You Bring:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 🎓 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related field (or PMP in lieu of degree)

  • 📊Minimum 15+ years of project management experience in utilities engineering or a closely related technical field

  • PE license and/or PMP certification

Desired Qualifications:

Candidates with prior training or demonstrated proficiency in the following are strongly preferred:

  • Negotiation Training

  • Proposal and Win Theme Training

  • Risk Analysis and Risk Management

  • Contract Law

  • Time Management

  • The Art of Supervision

  • Crucial Conversations

  • Scheduling

title: Go-To-Market Lead (Germany)
description:
About us

Hey there! We're Lleverage, and we're making the Autonomous Back Office actually achievable for businesses. We enable European companies to integrate AI agents into their business, because AI is only useful when it actually fits into daily operations. 

We help the most strategic European industries – manufacturing, logistics, and wholesale – automate the messy, manual processes that most tools can’t handle.

We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed scale-up based in Amsterdam, with big ambitions for 2027 and beyond. This is your chance to join early, have real impact, and grow alongside the company. If that sounds something you want to help build, we'd love to have you on board!

About the role

We're looking for a Go-To-Market Lead to open and lead the German market for Lleverage. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role: you set the strategy for Germany, build the first pipeline yourself, close our first German customers and own the German number. You'll work directly with our founding team, including our CCO, and you'll be the face of Lleverage in Germany.

As the market grows, you'll lead a small German pod. A Go-To-Market Associate will join you to run revops and German-language outreach and calling, and a Forward Deployed Engineer will join once the first deals are signed, to deliver for those customers.

Responsibilities

  • Open and lead the German market: build pipeline from scratch and close our first German customers, focused on mid-size and larger manufacturing, logistics and wholesale companies

  • Own the German number: set targets with the founding team and be accountable for pipeline and revenue in Germany

  • Own the full sales cycle: from first contact to signed contract, including C-level conversations and complex, multi-stakeholder deals

  • Build the German playbook: ICP, German-language messaging, channels and partners

  • Lead the pod: coach the Go-To-Market Associate on pipeline and work with the Forward Deployed Engineer on first deliveries

  • Represent Lleverage: with German customers, partners and at industry events

  • Work directly with the founding team: on strategy, targets, approach and customer feedback

  • Bring insights: from German customers back into product development


What we’re looking for

  • Around 10 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex deals and hitting targets

  • You have opened a market or built a sales territory from scratch before, and you have taken ownership of a number

  • A senior seller who still loves running deals yourself and is ready to lead a small team as it grows, not a sales executive who manages from a distance

  • You're an excellent relationship builder. You win trust fast, communicate with confidence at all levels, and genuinely enjoy the process of turning a cold conversation into a long-term partnership.

  • You're commercially sharp and consultative. You understand that the best outcomes come from genuinely understanding someone's pain, not pitching a product. You listen well and use data to shape your priorities.

  • You're energised by ambiguity. A new market with no playbook excites you rather than stops you.

  • Native-level German and fluent English

  • Based in Germany, or in the Netherlands

Nice to haves

A network in the German Mittelstand. Experience in B2B sales, partnerships, or business development. Background in SaaS, AI, or Consultancy. Networks in manufacturing, wholesale, distribution or the PE industry. Previous entrepreneurial experience is a big plus, built something, ran something, grew something. 50% of our team are former founders, that tells you something.

Why Lleverage?

Change the world, literally. Traditional industries are sitting on a massive AI opportunity and most of them haven't been reached yet. You'll be the one opening those doors.

Work, learn, have fun. We're building one of the strongest commercial teams in Europe. You'll work directly with the founding team, surrounded by exceptional talent, and genuinely enjoy the people around you.

Build a unique network. Lleverage is a global top AI brand. You'll connect with industry leaders and some of the most important operators in tech and traditional industry.

Get autonomy and ownership. You design the approach, build the relationships, own the results, and grow with the company.

Compensation. Competitive salary depending on experience, strong bonus structure (fi we win you win), and an excellent share package that makes this genuinely worth betting on.

title: Sales Engineer (EMEA)
description:
About Us

Constructor.io powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slow down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical.

We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

 

Role Overview

As a Sales Engineer, you will lead the technical components of the sales process. You will partner closely with Account Executives and prospective customers to design integration approaches, evaluate technical fit, and demonstrate how Constructor’s platform drives measurable business impact.

This role combines technical architecture design, consultative discovery, and cross-functional collaboration. You will act as a bridge between customer engineering teams and Constructor’s Product and Engineering teams.

This is not a demo-heavy role. Account Executives perform the majority of demonstrations at Constructor. This role requires architectural thinking, integration planning, and consultative problem-solving.

 
 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Sales & Solution Design

  • Lead technical discovery and solution design for prospective customers

  • Design and document integration architectures (APIs, ecommerce platforms, PIM, CMS, data pipelines)

  • Develop and support tailored Proof Schedules (lightweight POCs)

  • Deliver technical presentations to both business and technical stakeholders

  • Serve as primary technical advisor during evaluation cycles

  • Troubleshoot and triage APIs, SDKs, and integration patterns

  • Willingness to tinker and build demo prototypes and tooling

  • Build and present compelling custom technical demonstrations and integration blueprints tailored to each sales opportunity

  • Support RFP and RFI responses

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to surface prospective customer feedback to influence product roadmap and integration strategy

  • Contribute insights to the roadmap and the go-to-market strategy

  • Support enablement and training for sales teams

  • Help refine documentation, processes, and best practices within the SE function

Market & Industry Engagement

  • Stay current on ecommerce trends, AI/ML advancements, and the competitive landscape

  • Represent Constructor in prospect meetings, partner engagements, field events, and other industry engagements

  • Build strong relationships with prospective customer technical stakeholders (architects, engineers, delivery teams)

 
 

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in technical Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Pre-Sales Architect, or Technical Pre-Sales roles

  • Deep hands-on experience with API-first platforms: comfortable working directly with REST APIs, JSON data structures, webhooks, and SDK integration patterns, and able to troubleshoot them with Postman or similar tools

  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or similar languages, enough to read integration code, debug client-side implementations, and build lightweight prototypes or demo tooling

  • Experience designing and running custom demos or pilots with clear, business-aligned success criteria

  • Hands-on experience with coding agents to automate workflows, amplify impact, and execute at scale

  • Ability to read the room, tailor your communication to diverse audiences, and identify detractors, champions, and key decision-makers

  • Strong written and verbal communication, with a track record of producing clear technical documentation and explaining complex ideas to developers, architects, and C-suite executives alike

  • Ability to effectively articulate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Ability to empathize with prospects’ challenges and goals

  • Skilled listener with innate curiosity

  • Passionate about innovative technology, technical sales, and articulating value to prospects

  • Enjoys working with prospects and is comfortable interacting with C-suite executives from both technical and business perspectives

  • Professional proficiency in Italian, French,Spanish, German is a plus

 
 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in enterprise ecommerce or retail technology environments

  • Hands-on familiarity with at least two major ecommerce platforms, including how each handles catalog structure, extensions, and headless versus templated frontends

  • Deep understanding of data mapping between backend systems such as PIM, ERP, or legacy search indexes into a new target schema, possibly including product and variant structures, facets, attributes, and pricing logic

  • Working knowledge of search and discovery concepts

  • Experience supporting security reviews and procurement requirements, including GDPR, data processing agreements, data residency, and ISO 27001 or SOC 2 questionnaires

  • Ability to build business value models that connect search improvements to revenue, conversion, or average order value

  • Exposure to conversational or agentic shopping experiences, or retail media and sponsored product programs

  • Multilingual: Professional proficiency in languages other than English

 
 

What Success Looks Like

  • Prospects clearly understand technical integration paths

  • Proof Schedules (a lightweight PoC) align tightly with business outcomes

  • Technical objections are addressed proactively and effectively

  • Sales cycles are accelerated through a strong technical partnership

  • Product and Engineering receive actionable, structured market feedback

  • Qualitative (peer and prospect feedback) and quantitative (sales metrics and customer health scores) feedback will be positive and ideally, excellent

 
 

Working Style

  • Comfortable operating in a remote, distributed, and highly cross-functional environment

  • Able to manage multiple sales engagements and priorities simultaneously

  • A builder mindset that is proactive in creating structure in ambiguous environments

  • Highly collaborative with a strong sense of ownership and autonomy

  • Commercially aware and aligned with revenue and sales growth goals

  • Resourceful self-starter who can operate autonomously

 

You’ll Thrive Here If…

 

You’re a curious, skilled listener who genuinely enjoys untangling a prospect’s technical challenges. You get energy from tinkering and building, whether that’s a quick prototype, an integration blueprint, or a better internal process. Knowledge of manufacturing operations, change management, configuration management, and production planning processes.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to make data-driven decisions.

However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving.

  • Own it end-to-end. From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

Tech stack: Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

 

We're excited about you because

Who are we

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis.

We do not partner with search firms.

 

About

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Engineering team and help build and improve the products and systems behind Lokalise. You'll work closely with Product, Design, other engineers, and stakeholders to identify and solve meaningful customer problems, improve existing experiences, and shape what we build next.

Each of our engineering teams owns a product domain at Lokalise, from vision to delivery. Teams talk to customers, uncover their pains and needs, define their own goals, and choose how to solve the problems that matter most. We're hiring across multiple domains, so you'll own a real piece of the product and see your impact firsthand.

We're building an AI-native engineering culture where engineers take ownership of problems, not just implementation. We expect you to question assumptions, challenge decisions, contribute to product direction, and find better ways to solve customer problems.

  • Work in a Dockerized TypeScript environment with Vitest and Playwright for testing.

You Must Have

  • A strong sense of ownership. You're self-driven, proactive, and accountable for results well beyond the merge.
  • Strong collaboration skills. You work effectively with engineers, Product, Design, and other stakeholders to solve problems together. You share knowledge, give and receive constructive feedback, challenge ideas respectfully, and help others succeed.
  • A track record of leading complex projects end to end, from technical design to production rollout.
  • Strong quality and testing habits (unit, integration, and beyond) that let you ship fast without breaking things.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication skills, attention to detail, and a genuine drive to keep learning in a fast-paced, remote setting.

 

It's a Plus If You Have

  • Experience working in an open-source community as a maintainer or a contributor.

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Fullstack Engineer (Go / Kotlin & React)

About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in Helsinki or Berlin.

Please note: This role requires being based in Berlin/Helsinki on a hybrid basis. We are currently unable to offer fully remote work, visa sponsorship, or relocation support for this opportunity.

 

What You'll Do

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll contribute to products and services used across the merchant experience. You'll:

  • Build and maintain production software across backend services and user-facing applications.
  • Work on areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.
  • Develop reliable APIs, data models, services, and user-facing features.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and other engineers to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Own features from implementation through production and ongoing maintenance.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and improve the quality, scalability, observability, and maintainability of our systems.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow, while critically evaluating their output and taking ownership of the final solution.
  • Be willing to work outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve the problem end-to-end.

 

How We Work

  • Ownership: Engineers take responsibility for the features and services they work on, from development to production.
  • Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations.
  • Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.
  • Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

 

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

 

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

  • An AI-first mindset, with a deep experience in leveraging modern AI tools and solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.
  • Proven experience building production software in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments end-to-end and at scale.
  • Strong expertise in at least one area of the stack, with a willingness to contribute outside that area when needed.
  • Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, or similar, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.
  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, testing, and software design fundamentals.
  • The ability to work independently on well-scoped problems and collaborate effectively with others.
  • Good communication skills and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset.

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

 

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.
  • Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.
  • Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.
  • Integrations with external business systems.
  • Kafka or other streaming technologies.
  • Cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Kubernetes, or Docker.

Why Join Us?

You'll work on products that directly affect how merchants interact with Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash across Europe. The scope is broad and close to the business, giving you the opportunity to work on meaningful problems across different parts of the merchant journey while developing your skills across the stack.

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM) at Checkout.com, you will manage a portfolio drawn from our largest and most strategic enterprise merchants. TAM coverage is reserved for a select group of accounts, and you will work on them alongside our Account Management (AM) team. You will be responsible for the technical relationship, and together with the AM you will grow and maintain every account in the portfolio. You do that by unlocking the technical elements, removing friction from our technical products and, most importantly, making sure each customer has the best possible payment performance and technical health, so the commercial relationship can grow.

What you'll be doing:

  • Customer Partnership: Be the primary technical point of contact for the merchants in your portfolio. Build trusted relationships with their technical and product teams and run the technical part of quarterly business reviews, while the AM owns the commercial relationship and pricing.

  • Payment Performance: Monitor acceptance rates, decline patterns and authentication results across your portfolio, find what is costing merchants approvals and fix it.

  • Technical Consultancy: Root-cause decline spikes, integration errors and configuration problems using log monitoring and data querying tools, and see them through to resolution. Collaborate with issuers, card schemes and our internal teams that manage those relationships to resolve systemic issues.

  • Product Adoption: Lead the rollout of new products, payment methods and technical migrations as merchants expand with Checkout.com.

  • Account Growth: Spot growth opportunities in your merchants' roadmaps and collaborate with the AM on the best way to position new products and solutions. Strengthen upsell conversations with demos, workshops and technical training on new features.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with many teams across Checkout.com, including Product and Engineering, to translate merchant requirements into clear action items that deliver better outcomes for the customer, such as improved payment performance.

Qualifications

  • 3 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, managing internal and external stakeholders up to senior level.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex and unfamiliar technical issues independently and drive them to resolution.

  • Comfortable with core technical concepts, such as APIs and how front-end and back-end systems work together, and able to explain them clearly when advising merchants.

  • Strong data literacy, with the ability to use query tools and AI to analyse data, extract insights and turn them into improvements.

  • Experience with data querying and logging tools such as Datadog and BigQuery.

  • Comfortable using AI tools and agents in your day-to-day work to investigate issues faster, automate repetitive tasks and scale your impact.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to client sites as required.

  • Experience in payments or SaaS (software as a service) is a plus.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.
